sentences.text: Altruism is concern for the well-being and life of others independently of personal benefit or reciprocity.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

objectsOrComplements.text: concern for the well-being and life of others independently of personal benefit or reciprocity

sentences.readingHintZh: 主干是 Altruism is concern，concern 是表语。for 后说明关心的对象；independently of 表示这种关心不以个人利益或互惠回报为条件。

sentences.text: The word altruism was popularised (and possibly coined) by the French philosopher Auguste Comte (1798–1857) c. 1830 in French, as altruisme,
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误
sentences.readingHintZh: 主语是 The word altruism，was popularised 是被动谓语；括号中的 coined 与 popularised 并列。by 引出孔德，c. 1830 表示约1830年；句末逗号说明本句还要接下一段的 as an antonym of egoism。

sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误
sentences.readingHintZh: 这不是独立完整句，而是上一段的延续。as an antonym of egoism 说明 altruism 被作为“利己主义的反义词”使用；as 在这里是介词，没有独立谓语。

sentences.text: He derived it from the Italian altrui, which in turn was derived from Latin alteri, meaning "other people" or "somebody else".
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

relativeClauses.text: which in turn was derived from Latin alteri

sentences.readingHintZh: 主干 He derived it from the Italian altrui 中，He 指孔德，it 指 altruism。which 引导非限制性定语从句，补充 altrui 的来源；meaning 后解释拉丁语 alteri 的含义，or 连接两个释义。

sentences.text: Altruism may be considered a synonym of selflessness, the opposite of self-centeredness.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

objectsOrComplements.text: a synonym of selflessness, the opposite of self-centeredness

sentences.readingHintZh: 主干是 Altruism may be considered a synonym of selflessness，may be considered 表示“可被视为”。the opposite of self-centeredness 是补充说明，帮助理解 selflessness 的意思。

sentences.text: Altruism is an important moral value in many cultures, ideologies, and religions.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

objectsOrComplements.text: an important moral value in many cultures, ideologies, and religions

sentences.readingHintZh: 这是主系表结构：Altruism is an important moral value。in many cultures, ideologies, and religions 说明这种价值存在的范围；三个名词并列。

sentences.text: It can expand beyond care for humans to include consideration for other sentient beings and future generations.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

subordinateClauses.text: to include consideration for other sentient beings and future generations

sentences.readingHintZh: It 指利他主义，主干为 It can expand。beyond care for humans 表示超出对人类的关爱；for humans 修饰 care，不是不定式的主语。to include 引出扩展后的范围，and 连接其他有感知能力的生物与后代。

sentences.text: Altruism in biology, as observed in populations of organisms, is when an individual performs an action at a cost to itself (in terms of e.g. pleasure and quality of life, time, probability of survival or reproduction) that benefits, directly or indirectly, another individual, without the expectation of reciprocity or compensation for that action.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

relativeClauses.text: that benefits, directly or indirectly, another individual

subordinateClauses.text: as observed in populations of organisms

when an individual performs an action at a cost to itself (in terms of e.g. pleasure and quality of life, time, probability of survival or reproduction) that benefits, directly or indirectly, another individual, without the expectation of reciprocity or compensation for that action

sentences.readingHintZh: 先抓 Altruism in biology is when ...：when 后的从句充当表语，解释何种情形属于利他行为。as observed ... 是插入的省略被动结构；括号举例说明自身代价。that benefits ... 是修饰 an action 的定语从句，without ... 说明不期待回报或补偿。

sentences.text: The theory of psychological egoism suggests that no act of sharing, helping, or sacrificing can be "truly" altruistic, as the actor may receive an intrinsic reward in the form of personal gratification.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

subordinateClauses.text: that no act of sharing, helping, or sacrificing can be "truly" altruistic, as the actor may receive an intrinsic reward in the form of personal gratification
as the actor may receive an intrinsic reward in the form of personal gratification

sentences.readingHintZh: 主干是 The theory ... suggests that ...，that 引导宾语从句。no act ... can be truly altruistic 是该理论的判断；as 引导原因状语从句，解释行动者可能获得个人满足。may 表示可能，不是每次都必然获得回报。

sentences.text: The validity of this argument depends on whether such intrinsic rewards qualify as "benefits".
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

subordinateClauses.text: whether such intrinsic rewards qualify as "benefits"

sentences.readingHintZh: 主干是 The validity of this argument depends on ...。whether 引导名词性从句，作介词 on 的宾语；qualify as benefits 表示“算作利益”。重点是对内在回报如何归类的条件判断。

sentences.text: The term altruism can also refer to a deontological ethical doctrine that claims that individuals are morally obliged to benefit others.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

relativeClauses.text: that claims that individuals are morally obliged to benefit others

subordinateClauses.text: that individuals are morally obliged to benefit others

sentences.readingHintZh: 主干 The term altruism can also refer to a ... doctrine。第一个 that 引导修饰 doctrine 的定语从句；claims 后的第二个 that 引导宾语从句。are morally obliged to benefit others 表示在道德上有义务使他人受益。

sentences.text: Used in this sense, it is usually contrasted with deontological egoism, which claims individuals are morally obligated to serve themselves first.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

relativeClauses.text: which claims individuals are morally obligated to serve themselves first

subordinateClauses.text: individuals are morally obligated to serve themselves first

sentences.readingHintZh: Used in this sense 是过去分词短语，表示“在这一意义上使用时”，逻辑主语与 it 一致。主句 is contrasted with 表示被拿来对比；which 修饰 deontological egoism，claims 后省略了宾语从句的 that。

sentences.text: Effective altruism is the use of evidence and reason to determine the most effective ways to benefit others.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

objectsOrComplements.text: the use of evidence and reason to determine the most effective ways to benefit others

subordinateClauses.text: to determine the most effective ways to benefit others

sentences.readingHintZh: 主干是 Effective altruism is the use of evidence and reason。and 连接 evidence 与 reason；to determine ... 说明运用二者的目的，to benefit others 修饰 ways。两处 to 都是不定式标记，不是关系词引导的定语从句。
